text:
maya: Heads up — cost attribution dashboards show ~±20% day-over-day variance for tenant shards. Looks correlated with resharding windows, guessing ingestion/hand-off jitter.
jorge: ugh. can you share the aggregation we're using? could be double-counting during fanout.
maya: simplified query we use to roll up per-shard cost:\n```\nSELECT shard_id, SUM(token_cost) AS cost\nFROM trace_tokens\nWHERE sampled = true AND ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'\nGROUP BY shard_id\n```\nI had a 5m smoothing window outside this query but noise persists.
samir: two immediate ideas — 1) annotate ingress with a stable_logical_id so handoffs don't change attribution, 2) emit a commit watermark on shard handoff to avoid overlapping windows. both are lightweight.
alex_w: +1 to stable id. also consider a short-lived de-duplication key during reshard to avoid double-count. we can keep it off by default and opt-in per-tenant.
jorge: deterministic attribution (tenant_hash % N) reduces noise but makes migrations weird when N changes. need sticky mapping + migration shadowing for moves.
maya: plan suggestion: A/B experiment. Cohort A = current behavior, Cohort B = deterministic logical_shard header added at edge (proxy). compare variance and tail effects.
ops-bot: deploy started: infra/reshard/2026-03-20 by @maya :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: Samir — can you add a proxy opt-in flag that emits X-Logical-Shard and a metric attr.stable_map_hits? I'll flag 10% of traffic into cohort B.
samir: on it. PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/reshard-shim/pull/42 (draft). will emit attr.stable_map_hits and attr.handoff_drops. ETA: 2 days.
alex_w: also add a histogram for attribution-lag (ms) so we can see correlation with variance.
jorge: small caution — downstream enrichers currently key on envelope.shard_id. we'll need a fallback to prefer X-Logical-Shard when present to avoid mismatch.
maya: noted — I'll coordinate a short compatibility shim in the enricher to read X-Logical-Shard if present. keep old field as fallback.
alex_w: timeline? would like results before EOW so we can decide on sticky-map rollout.
maya: aiming EOW. if variance reduces >10% for cohort B we can widen. if not, try watermark + late-join crediting (+1 token to moved ranges) as fallback.
jorge: sounds good. can we add a dashboard tile that shows cohort variance, shard-moves/sec, and attr.stable_map_hits? I'll tix it.
maya: will file the dashboard tix and link it here when ready. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
